Afterwards, he becomes targetable again, renders the target ''Marked for Death'' for 3 seconds, and gains [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]] for the same duration.@@description2@@'''Zed''' also spawns a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' at his casting position for 9 seconds which is able to mimic ''[[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]]'' and ''[[File:Zed Shadow Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Shadow Slash|An icon for Zed's ability Shadow Slash]] [[Zed#Shadow Slash|Shadow Slash]]'' regardless of range. ''Death Mark'' can be recast after 0.5 seconds of his reappearance while the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is active, though not in the last 1.25 seconds of its duration.@@description3@@'''Marked for Death:''' '''Zed''' stores a portion of all pre-mitigation physical damage and magic damage he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' deal to the target, detonating at the end of the duration to deal physical damage.@@description4@@'''Recast - Shadow Swap:''' '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] to swap places.@@description5@@''If the target dies or is 1950 or more units away before the dash begins, Death Mark is cancelled, causing the ability to go on a [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] 0.5-second cooldown, '''Zed''' to reappear at the cast location, and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Shadow he spawned to disappear.''@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@

@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@Global@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@@@cooldown@@120 / 115 / 110 / 105 / 100@@targeting@@[[Unit-targeted|Unit]] • [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@Special@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * '''Zed''' gains a buff for 7.5 seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Death Mark''. ** The buff is granted on-cast and lingers for 0.25 seconds after it expires. * The [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is spawned the moment ''Death Mark'' is cast. * '''Zed''' will track the target if they change locations. ** He will dash through the target's previous location while still applying the mark if they are 2200 or more units away. * '''Zed''' will become targetable, apply the mark, and gain the [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]] as soon as his dash ends. ** The mark will not be applied to the target if they are [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] by the time '''Zed's''' dash ends. * '''Zed''' will be ordered to basic attack his target after reappearing. * ''Death Mark's'' stored damage derives from all [[basic attack]]s, [[Champion ability|abilities]], [[item]]s, [[Runes Reforged|runes]] and [[buff]]s. * While not being a damage mitigation, ''Death Mark'' does not store [[File:Hybrid penetration.png|20px|link=True damage|An icon representing the keyword True damage]] [[:True damage|true damage]]. [https://youtu.be/DGLC3oMoQMo] (unexpected).[[Category:Unexpected behaviours]] * ''Death Mark's'' [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is functionally the same as a regular one, but it lasts longer and can be swapped to regardless of range. ** The range at which it mimics '''Zed's''' abilities does not change. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the mark's application. They will not prevent '''Zed''' from initiating ''Death Mark'' against the target nor block the detonation from a mark that is already applied. * If '''Zed''' dies during ''Death Mark'', the ability will cancel instantly and he will reappear at his current location. The cooldown is not refunded. ** If he enters [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]] before the dash, ''Death Mark'' does not cancel. If he enters it while dashing, the dash is interrupted. * If the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] is interrupted, '''Zed''' stops, places himself to the ground (ends all displacements affecting him, but does not remove [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] effects), and reappears prematurely at his current location. The mark will still be applied regardless. ** '''Zed''' will remove [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] effects from himself immediately upon starting the dash. * Once '''Zed''' begins the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]], two [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will also appear to be dashing through his target, each one spawning a certain distance behind the target (from the right and left). These ''shadows'' do '''not''' mimic abilities and disappear immediately after they stop dashing but they grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of their surroundings. ** These ''shadows'' have a tracking distance of 2200 and a dash speed of 1750. * ''Death Mark'' does not cancel if the target enters a [[File:Zombie icon.png|20px|link=Death#Zombie_states|An icon representing the keyword Zombie state]] [[:Death#Zombie_states|zombie state]] before the dash begins. * If the mark's post-mitigation damage is higher than the target's '''current''' health, a ''spinning shuriken'' will appear above the victim. This does not necessarily mean the target will die, as it does not consider [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]] or forms of [[damage modifier]]s that are not respected by this predictive calculation.
